tests.name: the HMI loads and connects to the live feed
tests.detail: websocket live, mode SHUTDOWN COLD, 0.0 MW

tests.name: no JavaScript errors on load or during operation
tests.detail: clean console

tests.name: the 3D station renders (canvas is not blank)
tests.detail: 411 meshes in the scene graph, 35978 triangles per frame

tests.name: the guided start-up tutorial offers itself on first visit
tests.detail: first step "1 · Before you start" with 2 controls

tests.name: tutorial step 1 waits for the operator (does not auto-advance)
tests.detail: still on step 1 after 3 s of live snapshots

tests.name: the tutorial highlights the control each step is about
tests.detail: "2 · Set time acceleration" highlights #speed and shows a live readout

tests.name: tutorial assist buttons drive the plant, not just the text
tests.detail: time acceleration now 60× (selector 60×)

tests.name: the tutorial advances only when the plant condition is met
tests.detail: step 3 → 4, plant mode PRESTART

tests.name: the tutorial runs the whole cold start-up to a loaded unit
tests.detail: completed in 375 simulated minutes at 308 MW (70 s wall)

tests.name: the completion summary reports the achieved operating point
tests.detail: 7-row operating summary shown

tests.name: the autopilot takes the unit the rest of the way to load hands-off
tests.detail: autopilot did not raise load: 555 → 555 MW (state OFF)

tests.name: the autopilot button label never disagrees with the autopilot state
tests.detail: label tracked the state across 12 snapshots

tests.name: the bottom bar shows the build version and source commit
tests.detail: v1.0.0 · fde2b5b

tests.name: the build stamp sits in the top-right corner of the window, on screen
tests.detail: top-right of the window at 1024–1920 px, 14 px from the edge, never covered

tests.name: operator controls stay clickable with the tutorial panel open
sound is off by default and starts on the operator's click
tests.detail: AudioContext running, graph built

tests.name: the plant sound is actually synthesised (measured on the master bus)
tests.detail: master bus rms 0.0195, peak 0.058 (no clipping)

tests.name: sound tracks the plant: each bus is driven by its own variable
tests.detail: turbine bus is 0 with the machine at speed

tests.name: volume control works and the setting survives a reload
tests.detail: master gain 0.251, setting restored after reload (25 %, 🔊 SOUND ON)

tests.name: all eight side tabs open and render content
tests.detail: 8 tabs: alarms, plant, boiler, turb, bop, faults, proc, events

tests.name: every 3D view preset works without errors
tests.detail: 9 camera presets: overview, boilers, furnace, turbine, turbineDeck, tower, coal, fgd, topDown

tests.name: layout is usable at 1366×768 and 1920×1080 (no overflow, no overlap)
primary controls are reachable and labelled
tests.detail: 12 controls in the bottom bar, all labelled and ≥40 px wide

tests.name: faults can be injected and cleared from the Faults tab
tests.detail: filter → inject → symptoms shown → clear (TUBE_LEAK)

tests.name: the operator UI gives no hint that the admin console exists
tests.detail: no mention, no link; robots.txt disallows the path

tests.name: the hidden console still loads and offers one-time registration
tests.detail: reachable at /admin, registrationOpen=true

tests.name: the autopilot refuses to engage on a latched trip and says why
tests.detail: refused — "autopilot cannot engage — MFT latched (Blr A drum level HHH)"

tests.name: the RESET PLANT button returns the simulator to a cold unit
tests.detail: 0 MW / 0 events → SHUTDOWN_COLD, 0 MW, clock 0 min, 0 events

tests.name: arming RESET PLANT neither shifts the bar nor stays silent
tests.detail: idle 186px → armed 186px at the same spot; "⟲ CONFIRM RESET (8s)" → "⟲ RESET PLANT"

tests.name: a console that fails to boot says so instead of going silently dead
tests.detail: blocked /js/app.js → the watchdog tells the operator to hard-reload

tests.name: no JavaScript errors accumulated over the whole session
tests.detail: 0 console errors, 0 page errors

tests.name: Tutorial and sound state are stored per browser
tests.detail: The tutorial auto-offers itself once per browser (localStorage "tcsim.tutorialSeen") and the sound preference persists per browser. Clear site data — or use the 🎓 TUTORIAL button — to run the guided start-up again on the same machine.
